title: Eliminate interactive TIA Openness access popup for trusted worker
goal: Make trusted Windows/TIA execution non-interactive by synchronizing the current TiaV21Worker.exe Siemens Openness whitelist entry before any TIA Portal connection, with a one-time narrowly-scoped elevated bootstrap for registry ACLs.
scope: Coding-agent scope: src/TiaV21Worker/** and a narrowly-scoped Windows bootstrap script under scripts/windows/** only.

Before every code path that creates or attaches a Siemens.Engineering.TiaPortal instance, synchronize the current executable's own Siemens Openness whitelist Entry values: Path, DateModified, FileHash.
Derive the whitelist version from the loaded Siemens.Engineering assembly major/minor where practical (V21 => 21.0); do not silently target unrelated TIA versions.
Compute FileHash as SHA-256 of the executable encoded Base64 and DateModified from LastWriteTimeUtc formatted yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.fff, matching Siemens documented whitelist identity semantics.
Modify only the application-specific TiaV21Worker.exe whitelist key. Do not disable UAC, firewall, TIA security, or grant write rights to the whole Siemens Openness registry tree.

Provide an idempotent one-time elevated PowerShell bootstrap that creates/locates only the TiaV21Worker.exe application key and grants the current runner Windows identity the minimum registry rights needed for subsequent worker self-sync.
If whitelist self-sync is not permitted, fail before any TIA Portal connection with a sanitized bootstrap-required diagnostic; do not fall through to the interactive Siemens Openness access prompt.
Do not modify .github/**, agents/**, tasks/**, runner configuration, secrets, vendor library payload handling, generator/domain/compiler semantics, or IndustrialMDE.

requirements: Candidate changes stay within src/TiaV21Worker/** and scripts/windows/**.
No candidate Windows/TIA execution occurs; candidate validation is Linux-only.
All TiaPortal create/attach paths are guarded by whitelist synchronization before Openness access.
Whitelist synchronization writes only Path, DateModified, and FileHash beneath this application's own TiaV21Worker.exe Entry key.
FileHash uses SHA-256 Base64 and DateModified uses UTC yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.fff.
Registry version selection is deterministic from Siemens.Engineering assembly major/minor or an equivalently bounded V21-safe mechanism.
Access denied or missing bootstrap permission exits before TIA connection and exposes no user-profile/full runner path in public-facing failure text.
Bootstrap script requires elevation, is idempotent, and grants minimum rights only on the TiaV21Worker.exe application key, never the parent Whitelist/Openness tree.
No UAC/firewall/security control is disabled and no global registry ACL is loosened.
Primary connected ChatGPT performs independent exact-SHA CODE_REVIEW because candidate code is authored by the coding agent.
tia: After merge, perform the one-time elevated bootstrap on TIA-V21-PC if the worker reports bootstrap-required.
No interactive Openness access (0033:000666) dialog may appear during the trusted run.
This task does not require OLQ-001 PASS; the existing retrieve-with-upgrade EngineeringTargetInvocationException is a separate migration defect.
